text: General Information Programs are divided by foundational, intermediate and advanced classes. Students who successfully completed the study will be conferred relative certificates of University of Jinan. Courses Provided • Obligatory Courses: Basic Chinese, Listening Comprehension, Conversation, Reading, Composition, etc. • Optional Courses: Ancient Chinese Language, Contemporary Chinese, Professional Chinese, Chinese Classics, Philosophy, History of Chinese Culture, Chinese Calligraphy, Martial Arts, Chinese Traditional Handcraft, etc. • Lessons can also be decided according to specific needs of the students. Teaching Arrangements • Students will study 3 hours every day from Monday to Friday. • Term trips will be arranged to relative historical and cultural sites. Characteristic and Advantage Student tutors (majoring in Teaching Chinese as a Foreign Language) will be arranged to help language learners with their Chinese language study.
